items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Alan and I went to camp together... It was such – it’s still a great relationship.

ctx.x: Let’s set it straight. Let’s keep it straight. Another thing that I haven’t heard anybody talk about – I was wondering if you would comment on this – there seems to be, at least from my experience as a drummer, also – is that there seems to be a particular style that one could associate with Boston drummers, which you seem to epitomize.
What do you when you say “epitomize” mean? I don’t really – I think at one time, yeah, because – Alan [Dawson] – I didn’t let you finish. I wasn’t fair, right?
You know what I’m talking about.
